# Nook Melbourne: student apartments in Southbank, Melbourne

> Rent a furnished apartment in Southbank, Melbourne, for your group of students from Mexico on a semester exchange, with a living room, dining table and kitchen.

Nook Melbourne (https://nookmelbourne.com.au/) rents furnished apartments on City Road, Southbank, Melbourne VIC 3006, Australia, to groups of students staying for a semester. We rent whole furnished apartments on City Road, Southbank, in Melbourne, to one group at a time. The site is in Mexican Spanish with an English version.

## Apartment types

- **2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom**: 4 single beds, two to a bedroom (Bedroom 1: 2 single beds; Bedroom 2: 2 single beds). If your group wants a different layout, tell us and we will arrange the beds. [English](https://nookmelbourne.mx/en/2-bedroom-1-bathroom/) · [Español](https://nookmelbourne.mx/2-recamaras-1-bano/)
- **2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms**: 4 beds: two singles, plus two queens or two singles (Bedroom 1: 2 single beds; Bedroom 2: 2 queen beds or 2 single beds). If your group wants a different layout, tell us and we will arrange the beds. [English](https://nookmelbourne.mx/en/2-bedroom-2-bathroom/) · [Español](https://nookmelbourne.mx/2-recamaras-2-banos/)
- **3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms**: 6 single beds, two to a bedroom (Bedroom 1: 2 single beds; Bedroom 2: 2 single beds; Bedroom 3: 2 single beds). If your group wants a different layout, tell us and we will arrange the beds. [English](https://nookmelbourne.mx/en/3-bedroom-2-bathroom/) · [Español](https://nookmelbourne.mx/3-recamaras-2-banos/)

We have hosted over 300 students on exchange for over 10 years, and students from Mexico have spent multiple semesters with us.

## Space

Your apartment has bedrooms, a living room, a dining table and a kitchen for your group, with a large-screen TV, fast internet and great amenities in the building: a pool, a gym and a tennis court. There is a full kitchen with a gas stove and dishwasher, and the apartment has a washing machine, a separate dryer and air conditioning.

- A proper dining table
- Separate living area with sofas
- Full kitchen with gas stove
- Washing machine and dryer
- Large-screen TV
- Fast internet

## The building

The building has a front desk staffed 24 hours. Your access fob gets you into the pool, the gym and the tennis court. (Pool, Gym, Tennis court)

## The area

Southbank is a part of Melbourne where people live, party and enjoy life like Roma/Condesa in the city. The riverside promenade is about 7 minutes' walk from the apartment, and the Southgate restaurants open every day until late. This is where you want to be.
We have all of our apartments in Southbank, which is the best location in Melbourne. Other locations such as Central downtown and Docklands are mostly offices which are quiet at night and have no nightlife.
For everyday shopping there is a supermarket across the road, and others about 4 or 5 minutes' walk away.

## How to enquire

Message us from Mexico, get a quote, talk to us on Zoom, and book before you fly. 1. You message us: Send us your arrival and departure dates on WhatsApp, how many people are coming and which size of apartment you're after. 2. We send options: We reply with the apartments we have for those dates, how the beds are set up and a quote. 3. We talk on Zoom: We get on a Zoom call with your group and answer all your questions about Melbourne, Southbank, the nightlife, university, banking, etc. 4. You book it: You book the apartment before leaving Mexico, with the quote in writing in the chat. 5. You arrive in Melbourne: We meet you and check you into your apartment on City Road, to make sure you're comfortable and have everything you need.
WhatsApp: https://wa.me/61452669352. Email: info@nookmelbourne.com.au. Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/nookmelbourne/

## After you book

From the day you book to the day you settle in, you deal with us directly. Your bank account: When you arrive, we give you information on opening a bank account. You open the account yourself, directly with the bank. Where to buy groceries: We tell you where to buy food and fresh fruit and vegetables. There is a supermarket across the road and South Melbourne Market is close by. Mexican ingredients in Melbourne: We tell you where to find Mexican ingredients and tortillas in Melbourne, to cook in your apartment. Dinner at our place: We invite you and your group to dinner at our home. We cook Mexican food, so you miss the food back home a little less.
